pixel_transform: x=u*W; y=(1-v)*H; sample pixel centers at x+0.5,y+0.5. W/H are explicit parameters, never inferred from shape.
surface_rules: Part + native physical UV island + per-triangle dominant outward facing. No upper/lower or left/right inference from atlas order.
review_filter: Coplanar duplicates prefer greater UV area at XYZ quantization 0.1 mm. This is a review heuristic, not proof of game visibility; raw geometry is retained.
